faqs.q: Sec. 38-305. - Persons under age 21 prohibited on premises.
faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for a person under the age of 21 years to be admitted to or be
               on the premises of a smoking business.
(b)
The owner, operator, manager, or other person who controls a smoking business shall
               post and keep at all times visible to the public in a conspicuous place on the premises,
               a sign to be provided by the city clerk's office which shall read as follows:
"WARNING: It is illegal for any person under 21 years of age to be on the premises
               of this business, and upon conviction, a fine may be imposed."
(
Ord. No. 4003, § 1, 6-5-2006
;
Ord. No. 4127, § 3, 10-6-2008
;
Ord. No. 4501, § 4, 5-4-2015
; Ord. No.
4773
, § 3, 8-16-2021)
Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4773, § 3, adopted Aug. 16, 2021, changed the title of § 38-305 from "Minors
               prohibited on premises" to read as set out herein.
